# eRST primary source (local copy, not committed except this note)

- Zeldes, Aoyama, Liu, Peng, Das, Gessler. *eRST: A Signaled Graph Theory of Discourse Relations and Organization.* arXiv:2403.13560v2 (28 Aug 2024); published in Computational Linguistics 51(1), 2025. https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13560
- Retrieved 2026-10-05 for the CR-010 STOP 3 audit. The PDF and its text extraction (`pdftotext -layout`) stay in `data/raw/` (gitignored). The licence was not checked, so the files are not redistributed.
- Used: Appendix A, Table A.1 (relation labels and nuclearity), the nuclearity legend, Section 3.3 and Table 1 (signal types and subtypes), Section 3.2 (secondary edges express relations, not prominence).
- Note: this is the arXiv v2 text; the journal version was not compared.
